_comment: Copy to n8n/config.local.json (git-ignored), fill in, then: npm run n8n:build && npm run n8n:push
DASHBOARD_WEBHOOK_SECRET: same value as WEBHOOK_SECRET in the dashboard .env
PUBLIC_N8N_URL: https://your-public-n8n-host (prospects click time buttons here; empty = plain-text times, reply to pick)
CAL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN: long-random-string-used-as ?token= on the Cal.com webhook URL
